pivot: centre of the threshold on the ground; the gate faces -Y in Blender (Unity +Z after the FBX axis conversion): the giant walks out towards -Y

Open.note: the first and only opening; rumble 0-30 (camera shake, dust off the arch), crack: the knot flares and collapses, drawing its four shards in (flash + shard burst VFX at Seal), first light: the seams part (raise the emission and a point light inside), the petals fold into slots in the arch from swing_start, bottom first (round 53: each folds flat along its rim's normal, as one piece, and goes to nothing inside the stone); spawn the giant in the flash at first_light or when fully open

Opened_Idle.note: stays open for the rest of the level; the opening is clear

emission: magenta crack lines, worn glyph bands, the soffit slot, petal rims and sigil, plinth sigil, crystals; suggested _EmissionColor strength 0.6 while closed (dormant), ramp to 2.5 from first_light to fully_open, then 1.6
round53: rebuilt as one band of stone on a plinth (build_ruingate53.py); same bones, clips and moments; the petal bones are scale-keyed (withdraw into the stone)
